record.question: What is vital statistics primarily concerned with?
options: Events related to births, deaths, marriage and disease
record.explanation: Answer C: Events related to births, deaths, marriage and disease. Vital statistics concern vital events such as births, deaths, marriages, and related events; the choice explicitly grouping these events is the best match. Source/context note: Vital-statistics systems also cover fetal deaths, divorces, and related events; “disease” is more commonly health statistics. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/nvss/index.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
